mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS "totalMembers", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_section) AS "totalPosts", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS "pendingReports", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE regdate >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND regdate < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1) AS "todayMembers", TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "updatedAt" FROM dual
SELECT member_num AS "memberNum", member_nick AS "nickname", authority AS "authority" FROM member ORDER BY regdate DESC, member_num DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT c.community_id AS "postNum", c.community_title AS "title", c.community_content AS "content", c.community_category AS "category", COALESCE(m.member_nick, c.community_nickname, '탈퇴 회원') AS "nickname" FROM community_section c LEFT JOIN member m ON m.member_num = c.member_num ORDER BY c.community_id DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT TO_CHAR(d.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "date", NVL(m.cnt, 0) AS "count" FROM (SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 14 + LEVEL AS day FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 14) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TRUNC(regdate) AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member WHERE regdate >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 13 AND regdate < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 GROUP BY TRUNC(regdate) ) m ON m.day = d.day ORDER BY d.day
SELECT status AS "status", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM report GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
